summary: Describes a new End-to-End protocol between a host and its packet switch node (PSN, also called an IMP) on the ARPANET and MILNET. It is an updated version of a BBN report and aims to fix deficiencies in the old protocol, improve performance and throughput, and better support the growing number of hosts. Anyone supporting a host on those networks was urged to review it.

eli5.summary: Computers on an old network talked to the network's post office using a certain routine. This memo rewrites that routine so letters move faster and fewer get lost.
